decisions.reason: It is an automation-related extension of the established offer that has been publicly mentioned, so the firm's sunk investment and public commitment make early withdrawal unlikely while results can still be seen as provisional.

Although it has only a low-visibility website mention and is an incremental build on the established offer, the lack of clearly poor results and the public launch still favor persistence, with a somewhat higher drop probability than more strategic products.

The substantial investment in a distant new area and the visible commitment of a dedicated page and design award would make dropping it a costly write-off and public admission of error, so escalation logic strongly favors keeping it.
